correctness.rationale: A complete independent point-to-line incidence backtracking enumerates 24 perfect matchings; complementary 14-edge Hamiltonian cycles are confirmed, and all subsets generate exactly 252902 nonempty faces and the displayed complete 14-entry f-vector. Reconstructed staged toggle matching on 21 edge positions yields exactly 126450 disjoint matched covering pairs, critical faces masks 1 and 674086 plus empty face. The entire reversed 1936998-incidence nonempty Hasse digraph admits a complete 252902-vertex topological sort, proving acyclicity; Forman discrete Morse gives one 0-cell and one 7-cell attaching to point, hence S7. Independent code and aggregate JSON provided; this is a finite exhaustive theorem, not an extrapolation.
